proposedClips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的侧面角度拍摄，坐姿躯干、双肘和整个哑铃都留在画面里；双手托住同一只哑铃，保持躯干稳定。
proposedClips.framingNoteEn: Match the side view. Keep the seated torso, both elbows and entire dumbbell visible. Both hands support the same dumbbell while the torso stays stable.
proposedClips.visualEvidence: Tan Sir sits upright on the edge of a bed, both hands supporting one vertically oriented dumbbell. 1037–1040s lowered behind head, 1043–1046s overhead return, 1052–1055s lowered and 1058s extended. Actual 2188 GIF is the same seated single-dumbbell two-hand overhead extension; 2189 GIF instead holds separate dumbbells and is rejected. Bed edge replaces the seat surface only, not movement or resistance.

proposedClips.framingNoteZh: 按示范的正面略偏侧角度拍摄，将双杠、双臂、躯干及悬空双脚纳入画面；使用能控制的下降幅度，胸部不适时不要强行继续。
proposedClips.framingNoteEn: Match the slightly oblique front view. Include both parallel bars, arms, torso and suspended feet. Use a controllable descent and do not force continuation if the chest feels uncomfortable.
proposedClips.visualEvidence: 807s arms extended on two independent parallel-bar handles; 810s controlled lowering with torso leaning forward and legs folded clear of the floor; 813s returned top. Creator explains breathing and limiting range. Actual 0251 GIF uses the same forward-leaning suspended chest-dip pattern, not feet-supported bench dips or ring dips.

rejected.reason: Actual GIF uses two separate dumbbells; source overhead extension uses a single dumbbell supported with both hands.

Source kickback is single-arm with the other hand braced on a bed, both feet grounded. 0333 GIF kneels on a bench, 0420 GIF moves both dumbbells simultaneously, and 1741 actual GIF is seated despite its English label.

Close candidate only: source demonstrates the same standing single-dumbbell elbow-extension pattern but adds opposite-hand support on a bed, absent in both canonical GIFs. A clearly labelled supported regression could be reviewed separately; not auto-published as an exact match.
Do not substitute dumbbell-handle push-ups for palm push-ups, or floor-based pressing/fly demonstrations for flat-bench variations. These source sections are not published as those templates.
